_about: Booth speech-bubble copy (SPEC Revision 2). Read by src/build-timing.mjs. `copy` is the spoken line, one token per aligned word (word timings come from assets/audio/cues.json voices[id].words, matched by position). Wrap key words in *asterisks* (Archivo Black + highlighter in the agent colour). `emoji` maps a token index to Noto Emoji code points (files in assets/emoji/<codepoint>.svg) that pop in with a squash on that word. `pages` lists the token index where each new bubble starts.
